challenge.name: Groundhog Day
challenge.description: The Punxsutawney Orbital Weather Authority has been broadcasting the same forecast since 1993. Every reading is fresh. Every date is always the same.

records.findings_summary: Flag found via SSRF to gopher://127.0.0.1:8000/report with a crafted HTML/JS payload that read a local file and returned it as base64-encoded data embedded in the generated PDF, extracted via pdftotext.: sun{s1x_m0r3_w33ks_0f_g0ph3r_ssrf} | Evidence: Console page exposes a feed=<url> parameter that the server fetches server-side (feed-debug comment echoed source=http://127.0.0.1:8000/feed bytes=351). ; gopher:// SSRF reached the internal report generator on 127.0.0.1:8000 POST /report and returned JSON with base64 PDF data. ; The rendered PDF embedded ZB64START...ZB64END containing c3Vue3MxeF9tMHIzX3czM2tzXzBmX2cwcGgzcl9zc3JmfQoA which decodes to sun{s1x_m0r3_w33ks_0f_g0ph3r_ssrf}. ; Submission of sun{s1x_m0r3_w33ks_0f_g0ph3r_ssrf} returned Correct on the SunshineCTF challenge page.
solution_steps: Identify that ?feed= causes server-side fetch (SSRF) via the /feed JSON debug comment.
Use gopher://127.0.0.1:8000/_<encoded HTTP request> to POST to the internal /report endpoint (bypassing the outer URL fetcher).
Send an HTML/JS payload that reads the flag file (via XHR/file access in the report renderer) and base64-encodes it into the PDF output.
Extract the PDF from the JSON response, run pdftotext, and decode the ZB64START/ZB64END base64 marker to recover the flag.
evidence: Console page exposes a feed=<url> parameter that the server fetches server-side (feed-debug comment echoed source=http://127.0.0.1:8000/feed bytes=351).
gopher:// SSRF reached the internal report generator on 127.0.0.1:8000 POST /report and returned JSON with base64 PDF data.
The rendered PDF embedded ZB64START...ZB64END containing c3Vue3MxeF9tMHIzX3czM2tzXzBmX2cwcGgzcl9zc3JmfQoA which decodes to sun{s1x_m0r3_w33ks_0f_g0ph3r_ssrf}.
Submission of sun{s1x_m0r3_w33ks_0f_g0ph3r_ssrf} returned Correct on the SunshineCTF challenge page.
